verdict.rationale: Zero is an email client, so saved snippets and templates are a fair axis to judge it on. The evidence shows only AI-assisted composing, AI-drafted replies, and creating or sending drafts. These are adjacent features, not reusable templates with variables or attachments, and nothing documents a snippet or template library.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can insert saved snippets or templates — with variables and attachments — instead of retyping the same reply
